description: Modify an existing invoice. Can update date, due date, memo, customer, department, terms, email, online payment settings, and/or lines. For lines: provide line_id to update existing line, omit line_id to add new line (requires item_name), set delete=true to remove.

allow_online_ach_payment.description: Allow customer to pay via bank transfer (ACH) online

allow_online_credit_card_payment.description: Allow customer to pay with credit card online

bill_email.description: New email address to send the invoice to

customer_memo.description: New customer-facing message visible on the invoice

customer_name.description: New customer display name (auto-resolved to ID)

draft.description: If true, validate and show preview without saving (default: true)

due_date.description: New due date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional)

lines.description: Line modifications. Provide line_id to update existing line, omit to add new line.

delete.description: Set true to remove this line (requires line_id)

item_id.description: Item ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use item_name)

item_name.description: Item (product/service) name for new lines (e.g., 'Sales', 'Catering'). Auto-resolved to ID.

line_id.description: ID of existing line to update (omit for new line)

unit_price.description: Price per unit (if omitted, computed from amount / qty)

sales_term_ref.description: Payment terms name (e.g., 'Net 30'). Auto-resolved to ID.

txn_date.description: New transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional)

name: edit_invoice
